summary: CAIR Action listed Jane Stevens as a preferred candidate in the Gilroy Unified School District general election, a tier the organization assigns on the basis of civil-rights and Gaza/ceasefire alignment but that falls short of a full endorsement. The preferred designation is the directional signal in the record for Stevens's position on Palestinian justice.
